source_snapshot.procedure: Qualify PCIe bus connected to CX7 endpoints.

old_problem: CX7 subtests/topology/effects and link/error/performance thresholds are missing; Criteria are unrelated.
disposition_reason: The CX7 PCIe qualification purpose is explicit. Module, topology and numeric link/traffic limits are runtime gates; readability/FW are auxiliary only.
decision_basis: Preserved every CX7 PCIe subtest and endpoint path.

test_case.purpose: Qualify every mapped CX7 endpoint-to-root-port path with the approved NVQual subtests and signed link/error/performance limits.
test_case.test_command: Verify package/topology; isolate services as required; run all approved CX7 PCIe subtests; capture per-path negotiated state, traffic metrics, AER and FW/health.
test_case.expected_result: Every required path/subtest meets signed speed/width/error/performance limits and recovers healthy.
test_case.pass_fail_basis: Readable output or FW version cannot PASS PCIe qualification.
test_case.recovery: Stop on path failure, restore services/link baseline and preserve evidence.
